summary: Read several closed ranges. The right endpoint of every range is strictly larger than its left endpoint. Two ranges that merely meet at a shared endpoint, such as one finishing at 2 and another opening at 2, still count as separate. Find the smallest count of ranges that must be deleted so the ranges that stay never cover a common interior point, and write that count.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
